  AUGUST 28, 2019
  9:30 A.M.
  LOCATION:  1201 SOUTH BRAND BOULEVARD
    STANDARDS VARIANCE CASE NO. PVAR 1908844

  APPLICANT:  Derek Frahmann

  STAFF:  Vista Ezzati
  PROJECT DESCRIPTION
  Requesting for a standards variance to allow the installation of two (2) roof signs, where roof
  signs are prohibited. This is in conjunction with a façade remodel for the Lexus automobile
  dealership which is currently under construction, in the “CA” –Commercial Auto Zone,
  described as Lots 1, 2, and 3, Tract No. 2482: Lots 1, 2, 3, and 4, Alveretta Tract; Portion of
  Lot 25, Watts’ Subdivision; and Portion of Lot 19, Collins Tract, in the City of Glendale,
  County of Los Angeles.

  ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
  The project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 11 “Accessory Structures” exemption
  pursuant to Section 15311 (a) of the State CEQA Guidelines, because the proposal is to
  construct two new on-premise signs.

GLENDALE PLANNING HEARING OFFICER
GLENDALE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PUBLIC HEARING MINUTES
  AUGUST 28, 2019
9:30 a.m.  Mr. Roger Kiesel, Planning Hearing Officer, opened the hearing in
  Room 105 of the Municipal Services Building. He outlined the
  requirements of Title 30 for the pertinent cases and described the
  provisions for appeal in Title 30 of the Glendale Municipal Code as
  well as the procedures for the conduct of the hearings.

  Mr. Kiesel announced that the agenda for the meeting was posted
  on August 21, 2019, at the City Hall Entrance, and on the City’s
  website.

Staff Members Present – Community Development Department
1) Roger Kiesel, Planning Hearing Officer
2) Vista Ezzati, Case Planner

(1) LOCATION: 1201 SOUTH BRAND BOULVARD
    STANDARDS VARIANCE CASE NO. PVAR 1908844

  APPLICANT:  Derek Frahmann

  OWNER:  Lexus of Glendale

  STAFF:  Vista Ezzati
  PROJECT DESCRIPTION
  The applicant is requesting approval of a standards variance to allow the
  installation of two (2) new roof signs, when roof signs are prohibited. This is in
  conjunction with a façade remodel for the Lexus automobile dealership which
  is currently under construction, in the “CA” –Commercial Auto Zone, described
  as Lots 1, 2, and 3, Tract No. 2482: Lots 1, 2, 3, and 4, Alveretta Tract;
  Portion of Lot 25, Watts’ Subdivision; and Portion of Lot 19, Collins Tract, in
  the City of Glendale, County of Los Angeles.

  ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
  The project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 11 “Accessory
  Structures” exemption pursuant to Section 15311 (a) of the State CEQA
  Guidelines, because the proposal is to construct two new on-premise signs.

  Staff
  - Ms. Vista Ezzati, case planner, presented the project. She summarized the
  project details, and answered questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  2
August 28, 2019

Applicant
 - Mr. Dennis Flynn of DFP Architects, and representing the applicant and the
owner, presented the case. He answered questions from the Planning Hearing
Officer.

WRITTEN PUBLIC INPUT
In Favor:  None
Interested Party: None.
In Opposition:  None.

SPEAKING AT THE HEARING
In Favor:  No one.
In Opposition  No one.
Interested Party: No one.

The case was taken under submission at the hearing with a decision to be mailed
out at a later date.

The meeting adjourned at 10:00a.m.
